content:
alicia: Heads-up — EU-WEST dedicated pool p99 spikes ~450ms since 04:10 UTC. Saw NIC drops on rack-13. Telemetry: p50 40ms p95 120ms p99 450ms. Anyone else?
ops-bot: ALERT: high-gpu-egress-errors detected on rack-13 (eu-west) at 04:12 UTC :warning:
cheng: I see it too. Packet drops from host egress queues -> toR port 2. Looks like cross-tenant egress saturation, candidate offender is tenant 'atlas'.
ben: Is atlas on dedicated or shared? If they're on shared, allocator fallback might be spilling them onto the same noisy hosts.
alicia: atlas is on shared. They started a long sampling/job around 03:55 and queue-length jumped on several hosts.
arjun: Typical noisy neighbor: NVLINK+NIC contention. Short-term: soft-quarantine atlas by pinning to a preemptible slice + egress shaping at host to protect p99s.
dana: Cost tradeoff: moving atlas to dedicated for mitigation is ~3x their current runtime cost. Maybe do shaping + allocator tweaks first.
cheng: Quick host-level test using tc could prove it. Example command to throttle their netns: 
```bash
# run on affected host
sudo nsenter -t $(pgrep -f tenant-atlas) -n tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 200mbit burst 32k latency 50ms
```
alicia: Can someone run that on rack-13-host5? I'll watch the dashboards and traces.
ben: Running it now on rack-13-host5. Command used below:
```bash
sudo nsenter -t $(pgrep -f tenant-atlas) -n tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 200mbit burst 32k latency 50ms
```
ops-bot: DEPLOY: net-shaper job started by ben at 04:27 UTC (job id ns-4312)
alicia: Update: on that host p99 dropped from ~450ms to ~180ms within 2m after shaping. Good signal.
arjun: Nice. Longer term we should add an allocator egress_score that prefers hosts with <70% egress utilization when placing shared tenants, so we avoid co-locating heavy egress workloads.
dana: Note: that allocator change will spread load and likely increase cross-az bandwidth by ~12% in sim, so ops/finance we need an impact estimate before rollout.
cheng: 12% extra bandwidth vs 3x GPU cost for dedicated — seems like allocator tweak + host shaping is cheaper.
ben: I'll open an RFC and add simulation outputs. For now let's keep net-shaper on for 2 hours and then rollback if stable.
alicia: I'll add atlas owners to the incident notes and ask them to throttle their job window. @ops-bot please file a follow-up ticket for cleanup and RFC tracking.
ops-bot: TICKET: INFRA-7891 created — "net egress shaping followup + allocator egress_score RFC" assigned to ben.
dana: :thumbsup:
